verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five powers of a trainee.
The powers of faith, conscience, prudence, energy, and wisdom.
These are the five powers of a trainee.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ sekhabalānaṁ etaṁ aggaṁ etaṁ saṅgāhikaṁ etaṁ saṅghātaniyaṁ, yadidaṁ paññābalaṁ.
verses.english: Of these five powers of a trainee, the power of wisdom is the chief. It holds and binds everything together.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, kūṭāgārassa etaṁ aggaṁ etaṁ saṅgāhikaṁ etaṁ saṅghātaniyaṁ, yadidaṁ kūṭaṁ.
verses.english: It’s like a bungalow. The roof-peak is the chief point, which holds and binds everything together.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, imesaṁ pañcannaṁ sekhabalānaṁ etaṁ aggaṁ etaṁ saṅgāhikaṁ etaṁ saṅghātaniyaṁ, yadidaṁ paññābalaṁ.
verses.english: In the same way, of these five powers of a trainee, the power of wisdom is the chief. It holds and binds everything together.
So you should train like this:

verses.pali: ‘saddhābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, hirībalena … ottappabalena … vīriyabalena … paññābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalenā’ti.
verses.english: ‘We will have the trainee’s powers of faith, conscience, prudence, energy, and wisdom.’
